title: Pair Prototyping
headline: Pair prototyping and the loop
tagline: When code gets cheap, the backlog becomes the constraint. How product and engineering fill it with good items, together, against real data.

parts.title: The constraint moves
parts.desc: Cheaper code does not ship more product. It moves the bottleneck to the backlog.

parts.title: Give me the prompt
parts.desc: An agent adds words to a short prompt, not information. Where new information really enters.

parts.title: An old loop
parts.desc: Boehm's spiral and Cagan's product discovery: the loop is old. AI makes it cheap enough for each item.

parts.title: Pair prototyping
parts.desc: When oat sells out, do customers switch or leave? The engineer's agent can see what the product person's cannot.

parts.title: Lock as you learn
parts.desc: Each pass moves decisions from the agent to a human, the hard-to-change ones first.

parts.title: Gates
parts.desc: Nobody generates the next level of detail until humans agree on this one.

parts.title: It gets built
parts.desc: Your brief from part 2, taken up the ladder, runs unattended.
